responsiveHeader.search: Integrated small Input shares the header controls row; title is above.
responsiveHeader.overflow: ActionBar measures its allocated container. Normal commands move to More; important remains visible; disabled states and command IDs persist.
responsiveHeader.penpotStatus: Live desktop and mobile compositions updated through MCP; stable component and main-instance IDs preserved.
responsiveHeader.verification: Light/dark browser checks passed at 1440, 1024, 390, and 320 px. Static closed More triggers illustrate overflow; browser tests verify the working menu.

penpotVerification.light: Targeted desktop/mobile native PNG exports inspected.
penpotVerification.dark: Surfaces and icons update, but native Penpot export retains stale text colors. Full dark design parity is unverified; Angular dark browser checks pass.
penpotVerification.stableIds: Both original composition IDs and main-instance IDs confirmed against the live library.
penpotVerification.linkedParts: Existing Table, small Input, small Buttons, and bottom-start/hidden-chevron/closed Dropdown.

fillHeight.parent: good-main-view layout=fill, with Table as a direct content child, or another bounded layout
fillHeight.scrollRegion: Only the flexible row area scrolls vertically and horizontally; the entire native thead remains sticky.
fillHeight.states: Populated, loading with or without rows, built-in empty, and custom empty retain the allocated height.

penpotVerification.mapping: Both published composition IDs/main IDs confirmed live; existing Table IDs preserved.
penpotVerification.light: Allocation inspected in targeted desktop/mobile PNGs. After theme switches native exports can retain stale colors despite correct live semantic bindings; complete export color parity remains unverified.
penpotVerification.dark: Surfaces update but native exports retain the known stale text rendering. Full dark Penpot parity is unverified; Angular light/dark checks pass.
penpotVerification.runtime: Grouped native column headings, scrolling, loading and custom-empty transitions, search and pagination verified in browser.
